feat(edm): sinker rough and finish with undersize from their conditions

A Sinker Burn now states its pass (single / rough / finish) and the
finished cavity size. A rough or finish reads its condition's undersize
and gap: the electrode must be the size the condition calls for, a burn
wider than the cavity is refused (past the wall), a finish that burns
short of it is refused ("leaves the cavity under size"), and the tip
stands one undersize above the finished floor. A finish whose undersize
is not smaller than the rough it follows is warned by name
(SinkerFinishOrder, advisory). The program verdict's box atom sees the
pair reach the finished size; the pair's CL is golden.

Fixes #543

Merge upstream/main (#1131 merged) into issue/543-sinker-undersize

Carries #1131's fixes (UI Electrode icon arm, edm_at_post refusal in all
three writers, the tip/gap bound) and main's #544 orbit and #545 side
burn. Hand resolutions:
- motion sinker.rs: main's two tip refusals (tip at/above the approach
  plane; lift not smaller than the burn) now read stand(p), naming the
  "undersize stand-off" when one is set, main's "spark gap" text kept
  otherwise; the side burn's tip uses stand(p) too.
- sinker_op.rs: condition_gap_as(label) and condition(need) unified as
  condition_as(world, setup, label, op, need), the others wrappers.
- types/sinker.rs, sinker_dto.rs, params.rs digest, sinker_page.rs,
  fixtures: keep both (pass/cavity beside orbit; pass rows only on a
  plain Sinker Burn).

Review fixes (NeoTech at b93e8fbe):
- SinkerBurnOp::pass_refusal: a rough/finish needs both cavity sizes
  above 0, refused by name at CreateOperation/EditOperationParams (the
  sinker gate), in is_sane and again at generate.
- An orbit on a rough/finish is refused by name until the size law
  counts it (#1355); a side burn's burn must be a single pass.
- Pins: an_undersize_stand_off_that_lifts_the_tip_out_of_the_work_is_
  refused_by_name, a_pass_without_its_cavity_or_with_an_orbit_is_
  refused_at_command_creation, a_restated_undersize_marks_the_pass_and_
  the_finish_after_it_stale, sinker_side's single-pass refusal.

Refs #543

fix(sinker): wear compensation stands off the undersize, compensating the depth burned

burn_compensated (#546) placed the tip one spark gap above each layer's
floor and ignored SinkerParams::stand, so a rough or finish (#543) burnt
through its own undersize allowance once routed through it. Both the
layer tips and deepest_tip now read sinker::stand(p) and compensate
r*max(0, d - (s - gap)), the depth actually burned, so worn_tip lands the
worn face on floor + s. With no stand-off set the burn is unchanged.

Pinned by sinker_wear_stand_off_without_a_rate_stops_at_floor_plus_stand
and sinker_wear_stand_off_with_a_rate_wears_onto_floor_plus_stand.

Refs #543
